usage:
Usage:
  argvus-terminal [kitty options]
  argvus-terminal --apply [theme]
  argvus-terminal --print-config [theme]
  argvus-terminal --print-tui-config [theme]

Options:
  --class <class>              Set the Kitty window class.
  --font-profile <profile>     terminal or apps.
  --tui                        Use the ARGVUS TUI Kitty profile.
  -e <command> [args...]       Execute a command in Kitty.
config_not_found: Kitty configuration was not found under {path}
tui_config_not_found: Kitty TUI configuration was not found under {path}
cache_create_failed: Could not create the Kitty runtime cache at {path}
cache_write_failed: Could not write the Kitty runtime cache at {path}
cache_lock_failed: Could not lock the Kitty runtime cache at {path}
